verdict.rationale: Together AI documents a first-party Batch API for asynchronous workloads. Users submit many requests as a JSONL file via `tg batches submit batch_input.jsonl --api chat.completions`, at up to 50% lower cost with a separate rate-limit pool, which directly delivers bulk processing across many items. missing for 10: bulk management operations on platform resources (e.g., models, files, endpoints), documented batch limits and status/result-retrieval details in the pack, independent or hands-on corroboration.
